lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Dense clusters of high-luminance circular pixel groups organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form a grid-like topological structure on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch or indentation visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
